reviews.text: Great store and great staff. Getting gerbils for my daughter’s birthday. Jamie was excellent at telling us everything we needed to know and helping us reserve the gerbils and all accessories. On the day we came to collect, everything was ready to go. The girl that helped us on the day (sorry can’t remember her name) was equally as knowledgeable and helpful, we left confidently knowing the gerbil genders, and even the date they were born! Will be back for everything we need

Bought 2 diamond doves and some feed here. Only realised when I got home that I was charged €25 per bird even though the price written up in store clearly says they are €20 each. I do not support dishonesty and will not be using this store again. If you do use this store, check your receipts after purchase.
